annotations.title: Get the public settlement status of a receipt

description: Read-only lookup of a settlement receipt by its canonical receiptId (0x + 64 hex, as returned by the receipt verifier). Wraps the public AGP-114 endpoint GET /receipt/:receiptId/status on the receipt verifier (default https://api.idphantom.com, override with PHANTOM_RECEIPT_VERIFIER_URL): returns the settlement state (settled/free/used), payment facts (from, to, amount, asset, chain), settlement tx, block and timestamp. Free, unauthenticated and rate-limited per IP. For verifying a receipt cryptographically from a payment_intent_id, use verify_payment instead (this endpoint takes the receiptId, not the account-internal receipt_ref).

receipt_id.description: Canonical receipt ID: 0x followed by 64 hex chars.

name: phantom_get_receipt

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.
